vibe_rationale: Community-trusted street takeover of Wellington's creative quarter, the closest NZ peer to SURPLUS in format, though larger and more civic than a curated scene.
fit_notes: Family and all-ages street crowd, so the audience skews away from an adult health brand, though sampling at scale is possible. Many partner tiers are listed but no packages are published, and at this size a meaningful partnership is expensive; it is a New Zealand event.
